data.body: Done definition update: Sourcing contract — strata-template-vars.sh and strata-config-defaults.conf must (a) namespace all exports with STRATA_ prefix, (b) operate safely under `set -euo pipefail`, (c) be idempotent on re-source via a guard variable, (d) never call `exit` (return only). S9 must include a contract test that sources the lib twice under strict mode.
